newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks steady to mixed in London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks steady to mixed in London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks were steady to slightly mixed in London but traders said volume was thin a week after Britain's handover of the colony to China.
Some interest centred on banking and utility stocks, traders said.
Banking giant HSBC traded HK$0.625 to HK$244.625 and Hong Kong Electricity rose HK$0.025 to HK$30.425.
The leading Hang Seng London Reference Index .HSLR slipped 2.56 points to 14,789.61.

"There was activity in the banks this morning and then some smaller activity this afternoon in Hong Kong Electricity," one trader said. "London had been driving the banks but the volatility has calmed down."
